Definition: to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication, to sport
BiblicalUsage: 1) to laugh, mock, play; 1a) (Qal) to laugh; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to jest; 1b2) to sport, play, make sport, toy with, make a toy of
